concerns.text: FR-001 requires downloading ≥ 15 GWOSC injection events and validating them. The current tasks (T013‑T015) only generate synthetic injections and stop after ≥ 5 valid events, so the functional requirement is not covered.

FR-005 mandates LALInference CPU‑mode parameter estimation on original and compressed data. The only PE task (T022) uses a Bilby “Fast PE” wrapper, which violates the specification and Constitution Principle VII.

FR-006 requires computing credible‑interval overlap for mass, distance, and spin. No task implements this metric; T024’s compare_posteriors performs hierarchical Bayesian tests but never calculates overlap.

FR-009 demands explicit exclusion of events lacking tilt‑angle posteriors and a final set of ≥ 12 such events. Validation logic in T013 checks for the field but does not enforce exclusion or count‑based filtering.
FR-010 calls for an injection‑recovery baseline (Bias_Original). No task creates or stores this external baseline artifact.
SC-003 expects bias measurement using credible‑interval overlap *and* hierarchical Bayesian shift tests. The pipeline only performs the hierarchical test; the required overlap calculation is missing.
SC-005 requires reporting parameter bias (mass, distance, spin) with confidence intervals for each compression method. No task generates such per‑method bias reports.
SC-006 expects SNR degradation to be measured against a theoretical SNR baseline. The metrics module (T019) computes SNR degradation but never references a theoretical baseline for validation.
